cause: Animatable boundary entered the tree at its default transform; Node transform changed afterwards while the server transform used to build initial constraints remained at the origin. A later body_set_state alone did not repair that initial constraint creation timing.
fix: Set the kinematic boundary transform before add_child/enter-tree and construct joints only in that correct initial server frame. Never reposition free rigid bodies to conceal the failed startup.
measurementCorrection: Measure joint endpoints before submitting this tick's new pelvis target so both are at the same last-solved time; render one-tick lag is reported separately.
headlessProbeCorrection: Dummy rendering cannot register a GPU skin. Headless tail vertex checks now use actual ArrayMesh bone/weight arrays, Skin inverse binds and solved Skeleton3D matrices; actual GPU capture separately uses skin bake after frame_post_draw.
